facts.sup_[0,1)|x^n - 0|: 1 for every n (limit x->1-), so not uniform

M1.limits: Checks the specific sequence x**n on [0,1]; the non-uniformity argument (sup = 1) is a hand argument confirmed symbolically, not a general theorem.

facts.antiderivative: ln|x| + C1 on x<0, ln|x| + C2 on x>0 (independent constants)

M2.limits: Divergence shown for the one-sided integral of 1/x on (0,1]; principal value computed separately and is a different notion.

solutions_through_(0,0): y=0 for x<=c, (x-c)^3 for x>c, any c>=0

M3.limits: Substitution verified for x>=0 and for the piecewise family on the region x>c with c>=0; the non-Lipschitz claim is checked through the unbounded difference quotient at y=0.

facts.f=-pi^2 cos(pi x): u = cos(pi x) + C, unique only up to C
facts.compatibility: int f = 0 required; f=1 gives 1 != 0 -> no solution

M4.limits: Residual and Neumann boundary checks on the unit square for one reference solution; the no-solution claim for f=1 uses the divergence theorem (hand argument), illustrated symbolically.

M5.limits: Exhaustive for this polynomial on a closed interval (stationary points plus endpoints).

facts.||e_n-e_m||: sqrt(2) for n != m (no Cauchy subsequence)
facts.right_shift_l2: isometric, injective, not surjective (e_1 not in range)

M6.limits: Finite truncations only illustrate ||e_n - e_m|| = sqrt(2); the infinite-dimensional claims rest on the hand argument.

Q1.limits: Exact for the stated two-level state (floating point, tol 1e-12).

Q2.limits: Checked at sampled times for hbar=omega=1; the sign depends on the stated Hamiltonian convention H=(hbar*omega/2)sigma_z.

Q3.limits: Exact matrix identities for spin-1/2 in the standard S_z basis, hbar=1.

Q4.limits: Exact diagonalization of the stated 3x3 model; perturbative statements apply for |eps| << level spacing 2.

Q5.limits: Exact for the Bell state; no-signalling checked for Z and X measurement choices (non-selective), not for all POVMs.

facts.pure_damping: T2 = 2 T1 = 100 us (upper bound in this model)

Q6.limits: Integrates the stated Markovian Lindblad model (amplitude damping + pure dephasing); confirms model consistency only and is not experimental evidence.
